svg.title: Wide CLQR vexillum with QR code on the crimson field
svg.desc: A wide crimson and gold Roman banner. On the left, a QR code encoding the URL github.com/lispnik/clqr is struck in gold directly on the crimson field inside a gold frame, with a small lambda emblem at its center. On the right, CLQR is set in Roman capitals above the mottoes Commune Lispque Romanum and Codex Quadratus Responsus, and the repository URL.
